svg.title: Moog Mother-32 connections
svg.desc: Connection inventory. Arrows indicate signal direction relative to the instrument. Locations identify hardware faces; the diagram is not a socket placement drawing. Physical control sections are listed below.
svg.metadata: Symbol vocabulary: NYU ABILITY Project / IDM SynthAccess; https://github.com/IDMNYU/synthaccess/tree/ee1ef12cec3a3fb6be59a7861f7df8848be2dafe/tactileSynthGuides. Original schematic geometry; physical controls do not imply MIDI mappings.
svg.text: Arrows are relative to the device. Locations name the hardware face; sockets are grouped by function.
PHYSICAL CONTROLS / see interface.svg for labelled positions
VCO / MODULATION: Frequency, Pulse width, VCO mod amt, LFO rate, Glide, Wave, Mod source, Mod dest
VCF / VCA / EG: Cutoff, Resonance, VCF mod amt, Mix, Attack, Decay, Sustain, Volume, VCF mode, VCA mode
SEQUENCER: Tempo, Run / Stop, Hold, Reset / Accent, Shift, KB / Step, Pattern, Bank, Key 1, Key 2, Key 3, Key 4, Key 5, Key 6, Key 7, Key 8, Key 9, Key 10, Key 11, Key 12, Key 13
PATCH BAY: Ext audio IN, Mix CV IN, VCA CV IN, VCF cutoff IN, VCF res IN, VCF mod IN, VCO 1V/oct IN, VCO LIN FM IN, VCO mod IN, VCO PWM IN, LFO rate IN, Tempo IN, Run / Stop IN, Reset IN, Hold IN, EG
gate IN, VC mix IN, VCA OUT, Noise OUT, VCF OUT, VCO saw OUT, VCO pulse OUT, LFO triangle OUT, LFO square OUT, VC mix OUT, Assign OUT, EG OUT, KB OUT, Gate OUT, Mult 1 OUT, Mult 2 OUT, VC mix control
